english: I am at a store with my younger sister. These clothes are very pretty, but some are too expensive. That one is cheap, so I want to buy that one.
reference: 我和妹妹在商店。这些衣服很漂亮,有些太贵了。那件很便宜,我想买那件。
topic: Shopping for clothes with my sister

issues.description: The reference is accurate and natural, but it uses vocabulary above HSK 1: 便宜, 贵, 商店 and 有些 are generally HSK 2 or 3. A strict HSK 1 learner may not know them. The English also drops "so" in the Chinese, which is natural and harmless.
